scope: No renderer, shared runtime, adapter, shell, camera or mesh changes; source and prepared package data only

quality.definition: Bit 0 VALID required; bit 3 LOSSY explicitly permitted for visual use; all other flags rejected.

photometry.formula: D=2*cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); linear radiance divided by D before interpolation; reference D(0,0)=1.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays normalized imagery; Shadows applies the existing fixed-epoch Sun bank.
photometry.limitations: No phase correction, Hapke roughness correction or cast-shadow recovery. Relative display brightness, not measured albedo.

display.units: relative disk-normalized radiance; linear grayscale display

frames.previewPolicy: Radial preview with ambiguous intersections withheld; retained triangle atlas uses closest original source point in 3D.
